test_title: PYST 75: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people are sitting between A and B when counted from the left of B. C is sitting to the immediate right of A. D is an immediate neighbour of both E and B. Who are the immediate neighbours of C?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only two people sit between A and B when counted from the left of B.

C sits to the immediate right of A.

D is an immediate neighbour of both E and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edef415c8ca0e2534542f0e5de227083bd16fce718a66d4d61f94ee7782d99b1.png] 

Immediate neighbours of C: A and L

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
